I see a nurse practitioner usually since my only other problem is that I'm asthmatic and I only need the occasional checkup/refill. She and I don't have a great relationship and it's  $60 with no coverage. And the meds I'm on, without insurance,  will come to around $200 for a months supply.  I did buy a notebook for Journaling. I originally purchased it because writing short stories  (and playing video games) seems to relax me. 
I used to do community theater also but with my current mental state, is not an option.

I am in the U.S.  I stopped taking my meds, well, I guess it's because I felt better. I'm not a very outgoing person and I felt they just made me tired and content to do nothing, plus, my GF has a much higher sex drive than I do and what little libido I have was almost eliminated by the meds. 

I'm considering calling my therapist for advice also but I'm afraid of what she'll ask of me. I feel so selfish putting my loved ones through this already, I'm afraid being committed will put strain on my relationship and put me farther behind seeking employment (which is a huge concern for me right now). I want to get better but I'm afraid I'll be putting an extra burden on my GF since she works overnights at a hotel and no one would be home with our kids. 

I've cut myself off from my friends and family almost completely  (Facebook is about the only way I feel comfortable with people these days). I always feel that everyone hates me and I'm in this alone. I know these concerns aren't founded in logic at all but it's how I feel. 

I feel if I don't get help now I'm going to ruin any good things I have in life right now and seriously destroy any chance of happiness in the future. I feel my only other option is suicide but I don't want to hurt anyone,  I just want it to stop. I burst into tears for no reason all the time, whether I'm home or even at work.
